mapper.sql: c.id, c.video_id, c.author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, u.level AS author_level, c.root_id, c.reply_to_user_id, ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, c.content, c.image_urls, c.created_at, c.like_count, c.reply_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id AND cl.user_id = #{viewerId} AND cl.is_dislike = 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comment_like cl WHERE cl.comment_id = c.id AND cl.user_id = #{viewerId} AND cl.is_dislike = 1) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS disliked
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.id, d.video_id, d.content, d.color, d.font_size, d.mode, d.video_time_ms, d.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM danmaku d LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.video_id = #{videoId} ORDER BY d.video_time_ms ASC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
